stem:
The graph models the linear relationship between the number of monthly payments made on a loan and the remaining balance in dollars left to pay on the loan.

Which statement describes the x-intercept of the graph?

options.label: A
options.text: The x-intercept is 60, which represents the initial balance in dollars of the loan.

options.label: B
options.text: The x-intercept is 27,000, which represents the initial balance in dollars of the loan.

options.label: C
options.text: The x-intercept is 60, which represents the number of monthly payments needed to repay the loan.

options.label: D
options.text: The x-intercept is 27,000, which represents the number of monthly payments needed to repay the loan.

visual_elements: Graph titled 'Loan' with x-axis labeled 'Number of Monthly Payments' from 0 to 60 and y-axis labeled 'Remaining Balance (dollars)' from 0 to 30,000. The graph shows a descending line with points labeled (10, 22,500) and (35, 11,250).
